meta.note: The thousand-crossing top-up: the structural nouns every sentence borrows (fim, lado, maneira, altura), the pt-PT identity words (sítio, pormenor, bica, o continente) and the last of the places.

cards.note: THE pt-PT word for place — lugar's everyday twin
cards.ex_t: Conheço um sítio bom para jantar.
cards.ex_trans: I know a good place for dinner.

cards.note: detalhe exists, pormenor is the pt-PT flavour
cards.ex_t: Conta-me tudo, com pormenores.
cards.ex_trans: Tell me everything, with details.

cards.note: in Lisbon uma bica, in Porto um cimbalino, everywhere um café
cards.ex_t: Em Lisboa pede-se uma bica, não um café.
cards.ex_trans: In Lisbon you order a bica, not a café.

cards.note: ao fim de — after (time); no fim — in the end
cards.ex_t: No fim correu tudo bem.
cards.ex_trans: In the end everything went fine.

cards.note: no início de setembro
cards.ex_t: O início do curso é já para a semana.
cards.ex_trans: The course starts next week already.

cards.note: three meanings, all daily
cards.ex_t: A entrada do museu é gratuita ao domingo de manhã.
cards.ex_trans: Museum entry is free on Sunday mornings.

cards.note: saída de emergência
cards.ex_t: A saída é pelo outro lado.
cards.ex_trans: The exit is on the other side.

cards.ex_t: O painel das chegadas está ali.
cards.ex_trans: The arrivals board is over there.

cards.note: pregar uma partida — to play a prank
cards.ex_t: A partida do voo atrasou uma hora.
cards.ex_trans: The flight's departure was delayed an hour.

cards.note: que idade tens? — how old are you?
cards.ex_t: Com a idade vem a paciência, dizem.
cards.ex_trans: With age comes patience, they say.

cards.ex_t: Tem este casaco noutro tamanho?
cards.ex_trans: Do you have this jacket in another size?

cards.note: metade do preço — half price
cards.ex_t: Comi só metade, guarda o resto.
cards.ex_trans: I ate only half, keep the rest.

cards.note: um bocado is the spoken twin
cards.ex_t: Um pedaço de bolo de mel, por favor.
cards.ex_trans: A piece of honey cake, please.

cards.note: de resto — besides, otherwise
cards.ex_t: O resto fica para amanhã.
cards.ex_trans: The rest can wait till tomorrow.

cards.note: por exemplo — for example
cards.ex_t: Dá-me um exemplo com esta palavra.
cards.ex_trans: Give me an example with this word.

cards.note: de maneira nenhuma — no way
cards.ex_t: Há maneira mais fácil de dizer isto?
cards.ex_trans: Is there an easier way to say this?

cards.note: ao lado — next door; por outro lado — on the other hand
cards.ex_t: Moro já aqui ao lado.
cards.ex_trans: I live just next door.

cards.note: o canto da sala; o canto dos pássaros
cards.ex_t: O gato dorme no canto do sofá.
cards.ex_trans: The cat sleeps in the corner of the sofa.

cards.note: na ponta da língua — on the tip of my tongue
cards.ex_t: Tenho a palavra na ponta da língua!
cards.ex_trans: The word is on the tip of my tongue!

cards.note: no topo da montanha
cards.ex_t: Do topo vê-se a ilha inteira.
cards.ex_trans: From the top you can see the whole island.

cards.note: ao fundo — at the back/end; no fundo — deep down
cards.ex_t: No fundo, tens razão.
cards.ex_trans: Deep down, you're right.

cards.note: à distância — remotely
cards.ex_t: Trabalho à distância desde a pandemia.
cards.ex_trans: I've worked remotely since the pandemic.

cards.note: nessa altura — at that time; the double meaning is very pt
cards.ex_t: Nessa altura ainda não falava português.
cards.ex_trans: At that time I didn't speak Portuguese yet.

cards.note: ao virar da esquina — around the corner
cards.ex_t: O café faz esquina com a rua do mercado.
cards.ex_trans: The café is on the corner of the market street.

cards.ex_t: Cuidado com o degrau à entrada.
cards.ex_trans: Mind the step at the entrance.

cards.ex_t: A torre da igreja vê-se de longe.
cards.ex_trans: The church tower can be seen from afar.

cards.note: how islanders call the mainland flights
cards.ex_t: A ponte aérea para Lisboa enche à sexta.
cards.ex_trans: The Lisbon air link fills up on Fridays.

cards.note: on Madeira, 'o continente' means mainland Portugal
cards.ex_t: Vou ao continente na próxima semana.
cards.ex_trans: I'm going to the mainland next week.
